system.specialAbility:
You belong to the Riverkin Halfling Bloodline.

River Swimmer. You gain a Swim Speed equal to half your land Speed, rounded down to a whole foot. A Swim ❶ moves you up to that Swim Speed without a check in ordinary water. Dangerous currents or a specific hazard can still require checks. You must still breathe air.
system.description: A bloodline of the Halfling ancestry. Its Root Talent is granted free by the character-creation choice.
